evidence.why: Captures the server's presented certificate and writes it as a per-host PEM under a trusted_certs directory (TOFU auto-trust).

Retries an HTTPS call once after pinning the certificate when a trust-chain SSLError occurs, and skips auto-trust when a CA bundle is set.
Distinguishes recoverable trust-chain failures from other TLS errors, showing the feature is fully fleshed out.
